acv.quote: We proposed six hundred K a year.

header.reason: Angela, the COO, signed with Adyen after we never showed a store return or a rollout plan. Tom thought Raj decided and that we had already won the web side.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with online orders that stores can't see or return.
findings.why: Returns broke last holiday season, and Angela, the COO, reportedly watched the returns queue in a store.
findings.quote: The store couldn't see the online order

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Tell the COO one company answers for both tills and website.

line.text: Stripe Terminal is a point of sale system that unifies your online and offline channels

findings.why: Angela signed with Adyen. Tom met her only once and treated Raj, the CTO, as the decider.
findings.quote: I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer store worries: installs, wifi drops, tills down on Saturdays.
findings.why: Raj said Adyen brought a retail team. After that, 11 of 14 questions were about stores. This is secondhand.
findings.quote: Raj forwarded me a list of 14 questions and 11 of them were about stores.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Replace the line has disappeared claim with a step-by-step till return.

line.text: Unify online and in-store commerce: the line between online and in-store has all but disappeared

findings.why: Bev, head of store operations, dismissed our one-platform slide and asked how a return works at the till.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a retailer story showing store rollout dates and who installs.

line.text: URBN consolidates $5 billion in online and in-store revenue onto Stripe

findings.why: Angela wanted to talk to the retailer in our case study. We also had no rollout plan to show.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'the tills' and 'one customer, one basket', not 'point of sale'.

line.text: Stripe Terminal is a point of sale system that unifies your online and offline channels

findings.why: Bev said it this way every time, while we kept saying 'in-person payments' and 'point of sale'.
findings.quote: One system for the tills and the website.
